summary.selection: Requires archived, 80%-supported identical satellite ownership in both v5 arms, held fixed for evaluation. Offline tracks. Initial 48h causal nominal TLEs. Fit 2D horizontal displacement by equal-satellite Huber timing residuals, +/-12.5 km, after an 8 s center residual gate; at least 3 unique visible interior events and nonparallel geometry.
summary.calibration: Time of steepest negative slope cancels every constant and affine shift per lane. Numerically rechecked c=10 kHz/GHz on every accepted measured event against c=0, error <1e-7 s; free c is unidentifiable.
